decisions.title: Delegation narrowed to Sonnet: all mechanical implementation, file searches, tests and routine execution go to Sonnet sub-agents (including every critic agent); the main session only plans, reviews architecture and validates
decisions.words: New rule AND DO NOT FORGET THIS: For all mechanical implementation, file searches, tests, and routine execution, use your judgment to delegate tasks to lower-power sub-agents running Sonnet. Reserve your direct reasoning capacity solely for high-level planning, architecture review, and final validation.
decisions.changed: Every sub-agent and workflow agent defaults to Sonnet (the critic runners take sonnetKeys for capture, gaps, confirm and every auditor); Opus only where he asks for it; validation means re-running the checks and looking at the result, never taking an agent's own report as the validation. Update 2026-10-06: he restated the rule at about 22:00 EDT on 2026-10-05, and critic/runner/deep.js and focused.js now default every role to Sonnet (commit 34a08701); Opus is an opt-in through args.opusKeys (deep) or args.model (focused), and the old sonnetKeys list, which meant Opus for every key left out, is no longer read.
decisions.rule: Delegation: all mechanical implementation, file searches, tests and routine execution go to Sonnet sub-agents with the model set explicitly on every Agent call; the main session reserves its own reasoning for planning, architecture review and final validation (re-running the checks itself).
decisions.where: Said 2026-10-03 on Claude account #2; Bailey's global CLAUDE.md (the earlier wording stands there); docs/handoff/NOW.md.
